title: Privacy Policy
body_html:
Research-only mock storefront. This site is a synthetic Hydrogen storefront generated for AI research and benchmarking. It is not a real merchant and does not process real orders, real payments, real warranty claims, or real customer accounts.

Information we do not collect

This site does not solicit personal information for commercial use. Any form on this site (newsletter signup, contact form, checkout-style flow, account creation, hardware registration, return request) is non-functional or operates only in a sandboxed manner for research. Do not submit real names, addresses, phone numbers, payment instruments, or POS device serial numbers to any field on this site.

Information that may be logged

Standard server-side request metadata (such as IP address, user agent, request URL, and timestamp) may be recorded for the purpose of operating the research site, debugging, and analyzing the behaviour of automated agents interacting with it. This data is not sold, shared with advertisers, or used to build commercial profiles.

Cookies

This site may set a small number of cookies needed for basic browsing (such as session state and cart state). It does not run third-party advertising trackers.

No real customer accounts

“Account” and “Order history” pages exist on this site for UI completeness only. Do not enter real personal information; any form fields displayed are part of the mock user interface and should be treated as such.

Your choices

Because this site does not collect personal information for commercial use, there is nothing to opt out of, sell, share, or delete on your behalf.

This is a mock privacy policy on a research-only site. It is not a substitute for a real privacy policy and does not represent any real organization’s data practices.

title: Return Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. The text below is illustrative and does not reflect any real-world return or refund policy. No commercial transactions take place on this site, and no orders can actually be placed, shipped, returned, or refunded.

By clicking through any checkout-style flow on this mock site, you acknowledge that you are interacting with a research environment and not a real merchant.

Mock return window

The illustrative policy is a 30-day return window from the (simulated) delivery date for eligible POS hardware. To be eligible for a return in this hypothetical policy, the item must be in new, unused condition, with all original packaging, accessories, cables, and documentation included. Items showing signs of use, missing components, or damage outside their original packaging are illustrated as non-returnable.

Mock return process

Under this illustrative policy, a customer would request a return through the support channel. If accepted, a prepaid return shipping label could be issued and step-by-step instructions provided for repacking the device. Items sent back without first requesting a return would not be accepted.

Mock restocking fee

Under this illustrative policy, a restocking fee may be deducted from the refund for hardware returns that are accepted but not in fully resellable condition (for example, opened packaging, missing inserts, or light cosmetic wear).

Mock refunds

Under this illustrative policy, once a returned device is received and inspected, a refund would be issued to the original payment method, less any applicable restocking fee or non-refundable shipping. Original shipping fees are illustrated as non-refundable.

Mock damages, defects, and exchanges

For the purposes of this mock, customers would inspect their order on (simulated) arrival and report any defects, damage, or wrong items immediately. Defective hardware would be illustrated as covered under the separate (mock) hardware warranty rather than this return policy. The fastest illustrative path to an exchange is to return the original item and place a separate order for the replacement.

Mock POS equipment terms

Hardware shown on this site is illustrated as sold subject to a hypothetical POS equipment agreement covering availability, order cancellation, and acceptable use. None of these terms are real or enforceable; they exist only to populate a realistic-looking returns page on a research site.

Again, this is a mock policy on a research-only site. It is not legally binding and does not represent any real merchant’s terms.

title: Shipping Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. Nothing on this site can actually be ordered or shipped. The text below is an illustrative placeholder for what a shipping policy for POS hardware might look like and is not a real commitment by any merchant.

Illustrative shipping rates

  • Standard ground shipping is shown as a flat rate calculated at checkout based on the simulated cart.
  • Free standard shipping is shown for qualifying hardware bundles above an illustrative order threshold.
  • Expedited and overnight options are shown for time-sensitive (mock) hardware deployments at higher illustrative rates.
  • Bulky items such as full POS counter setups are shown as freight-shipped with a separate illustrative quote.

Illustrative processing time

Under this mock policy, in-stock hardware orders would be processed within 1–3 business days, Monday–Friday, excluding holidays. A confirmation message with tracking would be sent once an order shipped. None of this happens on the research site.

Illustrative delivery time

The hypothetical delivery window for domestic ground orders is 3–7 business days after dispatch, depending on the carrier and destination. Expedited shipping is illustrated as 1–2 business days after dispatch. The mock storefront is not responsible for any (also hypothetical) carrier delays.

Illustrative international shipping

Some hardware listings are illustrated as available only in specific regions (for example, “Regional Edition” variants). Under this mock policy, international destinations may incur additional duties, taxes, and carrier fees that would be the buyer’s responsibility. None of this is a real shipping commitment.

Lost or damaged packages (illustrative)

Under the illustrative policy, a customer would report a lost or visibly damaged package within 7 days of the simulated delivery date so the (mock) merchant could investigate with the carrier. Damage to the hardware itself would be handled under the separate (mock) return and warranty policies.

This text exists only to populate a realistic-looking shipping policy page on a research-only site. It is not a real shipping commitment.
